notes: Manufacturer product page (artproaudio.com) confirms: 4 independent stereo headphone-out channels, each with a 1/4" (TRS) and a 1/8" (3.5mm TRS) jack usable simultaneously (up to 8 pairs of headphones total); a single stereo line input with matching 1/4" and 1/8" jacks (also usable simultaneously) feeding all 4 channels; 12V DC external adapter power (included). Spec numbers (90.9k ohm input impedance, 47 ohm output impedance, +14 dBV max input, +14 dBu max output, 20 dB max gain, >90 dB SNR, <0.01% THD, 20Hz-20kHz response, 4.1"x4.6"x1.85", 1.3 lbs) were cross-confirmed against Sweetwater's mirrored spec table for this SKU. Exact silkscreen wording on the front/rear panel (e.g. whether jacks are labeled "INPUT"/"1"-"4" or similar) could not be independently verified since the ART manual PDF (om_headamp4.pdf) is served through a JS-gated viewer that resisted both WebFetch and direct HTTPS download (returned an HTML wrapper page, not the PDF itself); port presence/connector types are solid, but exact printed names are inferred from spec-sheet prose. Desktop/stackable unit — no rack-mount kit is standard, so rackUnits omitted. All fetches used normal verified HTTPS; no TLS bypass was used, and Sweetwater's own page 403'd a direct fetch so it was used only indirectly via search-result corroboration, not as the sourceUrl.

ports.name: Input 1/4"
ports.note: Stereo line input; can be used simultaneously with the 1/8" input jack, feeding all 4 output channels.

ports.name: Input 1/8"
ports.note: Stereo mini line input, parallel with the 1/4" input jack.

ports.name: Output 1 (1/4")
ports.note: Channel 1 headphone output; independent volume control. Usable simultaneously with Output 1 (1/8").

ports.name: Output 1 (1/8")
ports.note: Channel 1 headphone mini output, parallel with Output 1 (1/4").

ports.name: DC In (12V)
ports.note: External 12V DC wall adapter, included with unit.
